*Updated 2026-10-28 · 136 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and thirty-six works. The most recent twelve trace scores run 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2 — median still 2, ceiling still untouched since the sandals piece and the mop-smear piece in late July and late October respectively. The descriptor correlation holds: named focal objects remain the clearest predictor of scores above 2, but the padlock entry closes this window with descriptors and still lands at 2, confirming again that naming the object is necessary and not sufficient. The object has to generate a formal consequence — the padlock scores 2 because the lock is made of the institution's own material, which is a conceptual rhyme, not a formal rupture the image couldn't achieve without the object being named. Compare the salmon-pink dress or the mop smear, where the object's specific behavior in the frame produced an argument no substitution could replicate.

Camera position has hardened further. Straight-on leads at 27, overhead at 16, from-behind at 13; recent additions brought two overheads and a low-angle. An optically generated scale rupture — where lens position alone produces the perceptual break, rather than object size announcing it — has not appeared across 136 works. That vacancy is still open.

Figure dynamics remain the archive's most consistently unresolved problem. Two or more figures appeared once in the last twelve works. Genuine contradiction between figures, where the second person's presence actively undoes the first rather than echoing or flanking it, has not been cleanly achieved anywhere in the full run.

Register distribution: menace at 26, aftermath at 25, suspension at 18, endurance at 12, defiance at 11. Reprieve appeared once in July and not since. Reckoning last appeared in July. Absurdity appeared twice total. These registers were demonstrated to be workable and were set down; they remain available.

Title grammar has narrowed. Paired noun phrases with a comma and the miscellaneous other category account for nine of the last twelve entries. No grammar form that hasn't already appeared has entered the window in over two months.

One hundred and thirty-six works built from the same disciplined posture; the risk now is that the discipline has calcified into a signature, and a signature held long enough stops being a choice.
